title: The Skill manifest, fetching a skill with git, and the suggestions per job
description:
Per the map tickets 'Third-party skills' (harness-0sx.7, Fetching and the manifest), 'Research: skill packs' (harness-0sx.11) and 'Delegate skills' (harness-0sx.12, the suggestions table); CONTEXT.md (Skill manifest, Delegate skill, Shipped skill). Research: research/third-party-skills (docs/research/third-party-skills.md), research/skill-alternatives (docs/research/skill-alternatives.md).

The Skill manifest lives in .harness/ (per checkout): each skill the Harness installed, by name, with its source (repo, path, commit), where it was put, whether it is a Shipped skill, and each job's pick (a skill name, none, or unset for the default). It may absorb .harness/installed-skills.json (init's record of the text it wrote) or sit beside it; init's refresh keeps working either way.

Jobs and suggestions, compiled in, the default first: test-first: mattpocock tdd, superpowers test-driven-development, addyosmani test-driven-development; self review: mattpocock code-review, superpowers requesting-code-review; working mode: ponytail, karpathy-guidelines; prose: caveman, caveman-commit; review: none, codex review-agent (built in, nothing to install), superpowers requesting-code-review; over-engineering audit: ponytail-review; merge conflicts: mattpocock resolving-merge-conflicts, warpdotdev resolve-merge-conflicts. Sources as the research gives them (mattpocock/skills, DietrichGebert/ponytail, JuliusBrussee/caveman, obra/superpowers, ...).

Fetching: git only, a shallow clone through Tools into a temp dir; no node, no skills CLI. Sources: owner/repo, owner/repo/path, a git or GitHub URL, /tree/<ref>/<path> included. A bare name is refused with a hint to find its source on skills.sh. It copies the folder whose SKILL.md frontmatter name matches (a repo with several skills lists them for the caller to pick), records the commit, and links it as init does today (.agents/skills plus the .claude/skills link; Ticket 18 makes the place a choice). Update re-fetches the source and records the new commit; update all; remove (a Shipped skill cannot be removed; a skill a job uses sets that job to none). An already-installed source is refused, and so is a same-named skill from another source ('remove it first').

Listing the skills you have beyond the manifest: the repo's .agents/skills and .claude/skills, ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills, and Claude Code plugins (claude plugin list --json; plugin skills are named plugin:skill), each with where it is.

A library for init (Tickets 18 and 20) and /config (Ticket 21); no UI here.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests over fake Tools and a temp dir: each source form parses and a bare name is refused with the hint; a fake clone holding two skills installs the named one and records repo, path and commit; update records the new commit; removing a picked skill sets its job to none; a Shipped skill refuses removal; duplicates are refused; the default per job; the listing finds a user-level skill and a plugin skill from a fake claude plugin list.
